summary: This Game Theory #16 lecture is already public Strategy and Imperial Retrenchment evidence for four-dimensional war and replacement-empire audition; its remaining impact is to keep Pax Judaica split across material succession, capital platform, sacred sequence, AI surveillance, and dated forecast families before any public child or ledger promotion.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: War is fought across narrative, political, economic, and military dimensions, and Iran reverses the American ordering by using military moves to affect economics, politics, and narrative.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public Strategy page already uses this lecture for the four-dimensional-war anchor. A later provenance pass may link the episode read mark, but no new public prose is needed.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Israel is auditioning to replace America by proving unity, capacity, determination, infrastructure control, and willingness to do what the incumbent empire no longer can.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public Imperial Retrenchment child already carries this anchor from the source. Keep the episode unlinked until a concept-scoped provenance pass can add several exact Strategy/Prediction links together.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Finance sets the game, wants the status quo maintained, and may back a replacement muscle when the American empire becomes a problem for the system.
existing_lens_links.rationale: Power owns the capital-enforcement migration mechanism, but this source supplies secondary support rather than replacing the existing CapitalCosm anchor.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: keep this source as the Strategy definition of four-dimensional war. The useful mechanism is not Pax Judaica as a topic, but the ordering problem: American military victory language tries to force narrative, political, and economic reality to conform, while Iran uses military action to move the other dimensions.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Strategy owns ordering, material audit, and adaptation. Prediction owns dated forecast status; Eschatology owns sacred role-script only when the source supplies that register.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: keep this source as the replacement-empire audition test. Jiang evaluates whether a possible successor can supply imperial muscle through unity, determination, cost effectiveness, infrastructure control, human capital, AI surveillance capacity, and corridor access after American retreat.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Imperial Retrenchment owns successor burden and proxy attrition. Power owns capital's safe-enforcement search; Chokepoint owns corridor and access mechanics; AI Control and Mass Society own surveillance infrastructure when that becomes primary.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold the source for Pax Judaica forecast-family comparison: Jiang predicts American defeat or forced retreat, Israel as replacement muscle, a possible Israel-Iran two-pole order, GCC fragmentation, and an economic/civil-war pressure path that could force the American military home.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Prediction owns source date, speculative caveat, object, horizon, comparison trail, and later miss/revision. It should not promote a single undifferentiated 'Pax Judaica' ledger item.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use as secondary support for capital migrating toward enforcement: finance and system beneficiaries need a muscle that maintains the game, so Israel appears as a possible replacement platform only after America becomes unreliable.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Power owns capital's search for protected enforcement. The March 26 lecture should not make Power absorb the material war-board, sacred script, or forecast ledger status.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold the Gaza/data-center material as secondary AI Control support only if future synthesis asks how surveillance infrastructure helps a successor platform govern bodies, routes, and digital systems.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: AI Control owns the surveillance/control surface. Imperial Retrenchment owns why that capacity is part of replacement-empire audition; Eschatology owns only sacred obedience and end-times role language.

new_lens_seeds.title: Pax Judaica As Capital Platform
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: Pax Judaica is not one concept yet; it is a comparison family where capital, imperial muscle, sacred role-script, surveillance infrastructure, corridor control, and dated forecast status must be separated before public promotion.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The mechanism recurs across March-April 2026 interviews and lectures, but each recurrence emphasizes a different active mechanism: replacement muscle, capital safe house, eschatological sequence, AI surveillance order, or falsifiable prediction.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Hold as a seed/comparison family. The recent Eschatology child split review already decided that Pax Judaica / ritual sequence is the more plausible future child, but only after capital, material, forecast, and hidden-coordination branches are separated.

chronology_notes.note: On 2026-03-26 Jiang gives a public four-dimensional war formula and uses the Iran war to show why a military story can fail when narrative, political, and economic feedback are forced to obey it.

On 2026-03-26 Jiang frames Pax Judaica as a replacement-muscle audition: if American empire becomes unreliable, system beneficiaries may back Israel as the actor proving unity, capacity, determination, and infrastructure command.
The lecture explicitly caveats the Pax Judaica order as theory and intellectual speculation, not prophecy, so later comparison must preserve source date, speculative status, and alternate outcomes.

This source predates the April 1 Kim Iversen capital-safe-house version and gives the material succession layer first: Israel replaces America only if America is forced out, while Israel and Iran may become a two-pole Middle East order despite ideological enmity.

canon_candidates.candidate: On 2026-03-26 Jiang predicts that America is losing or will lose the Iran war because it lacks reflection, flexibility, resilience, political will, manufacturing capacity, and willingness to sustain casualties.
canon_candidates.promotion_condition: Compare against later Iran/Hormuz, U.S. draft, and material-war sources; separate material diagnosis from dated outcome prediction.

canon_candidates.candidate: Jiang predicts Pax Judaica as Israel replacing America in the Middle East after America is forced out or made to implode, while Israel proves it can maintain the system's imperial muscle.
canon_candidates.promotion_condition: Do not promote as one ledger item. Split capital-platform, replacement-muscle, sacred-sequence, AI-surveillance, American-implosion, and event-status branches first.

canon_candidates.candidate: Jiang predicts a postwar Middle East in which Israel and Iran become the two strong regional poles, GCC states fragment toward stronger patrons, and the GCC no longer remains a major independent factor.
canon_candidates.promotion_condition: Compare with later GCC safe-haven, Hormuz, Iran, and Israel/Pax Judaica sources before ledger promotion.

canon_candidates.candidate: Jiang says the replacement sequence may require stock-market crash, oil shock, American discontent, and civil war so the American military retreats home.
canon_candidates.promotion_condition: Route through the existing domestic Caesar/emergency-authority and collapse forecast-family reviews; do not merge economic crash, oil shock, civil war, and military retreat into one claim.

next_actions.action: No public Strategy or Imperial Retrenchment append is needed now; both pages already cite the source and carry the durable anchors for four-dimensional war and replacement-empire audition.

If provenance maintenance follows, batch exact episode-to-lens links for this read rather than adding one tiny link: four-dimensional war to Strategy, replacement audition to Imperial Retrenchment, and capital-platform pressure to Power only where the mark is specific.

If synthesis follows, write a Pax Judaica comparison proposal that separates replacement muscle, capital safe house, sacred sequence, surveillance infrastructure, corridor/resource map, and dated forecast status before any child-page or ledger decision.

Do not create standalone Pax Judaica, Israel Replaces America, Greater Israel, Gaza Proof Of Concept, Lebanon Pager Attack, Two-Pole Middle East, GCC Fragmentation, American Implosion, or Civil War By Oil Shock pages from this source alone.
